title: Minimum Amount of Damage Dealt to Bob
summary: Given an integer power and arrays damage and health of length n, where each enemy deals Bob damage[i] points of damage per second while alive, and Bob can deal power points of damage to one enemy per second, determine the minimum total damage points Bob will receive before all enemies are defeated.
statement: Given an integer power and arrays damage and health of length n, where each enemy deals Bob damage[i] points of damage per second while alive, and Bob can deal power points of damage to one enemy per second, determine the minimum total damage points Bob will receive before all enemies are defeated.
constraints: power is positive; damage and health are equal-length positive arrays with at most 100,000 enemies.
All living enemies deal damage before each attack; enemy i needs ceil(health[i]/power) attacks.
Choose the attack order minimizing all damage received before every enemy dies.
hints: Enemy i is a job of duration ceil(health/power) whose damage rate persists until completion.
Use the pairwise exchange rule: i precedes j when time_i*damage_j < time_j*damage_i.
Sort with exact cross multiplication, then add current total living damage for every attack second.
Swapping an inverted adjacent pair decreases total damage by the cross-product difference, so the sorted order is globally optimal.

tests.explanation: Defeating enemies in order 3,2,0,1 yields total damage 39.
With equal damage rates, shortest required attack times first gives total 20.
